title: Every Single-Centred Black Hole Index of the \( \mathbb Z_2 \), \( \mathbb Z_3 \), \( \mathbb Z_5 \) and \( \mathbb Z_7 \) CHL Models Is Positive
content: Every single-centred black hole index of the \( \mathbb Z_2, \mathbb Z_3, \mathbb Z_5 \), and \( \mathbb Z_7 \) CHL models is positive. The proof rests on exact Rademacher-type expansions, which also pin each index between two explicit multiples of its leading Bessel term. For \( N=2,3 \) the twined indices are much smaller than the index, so that every charge sector of the black hole microstates has a positive index.
